newsitem.title: INDIA: India nickel, copper prices slide, aluminium quiet.
newsitem.headline: India nickel, copper prices slide, aluminium quiet.

text.p: Nickel prices extended losses, copper was weak and other base metals were steady in a narrow price band, dealers said on Thursday.

Nickel slid further by 300 rupees to 37,600 rupees per quintal on fresh offerings by the stockist following weak trend in the world market. Copper fell 50 rupees to 11,700 rupees per quintal on sluggish physical enquiries.
The market sentiment was also affected by Hindustan Copper Ltd's 3,000 rupees per tonne price reduction for October.
Zinc was steady at 6,200 rupees per quintal. So was lead at 4,950 rupees amid stray physical support.
Tin was quiet at 35,500 rupees per quintal and aluminium at 7,450 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.
